visual: Minimal black hero with enormous white type, lime-highlighted price comparison, realistic console previews, editorial feature imagery and provider globe.
judgment: Useful product-clarity benchmark; visual interest comes from the product sections more than the sparse hero.
role: Decentralized compute marketplace. AKT staking/governance and current documented burn/mint mechanism for stable deployment credits.
routes: Deploy Now, pricing, console, docs and provider entry points.
loop: Workload deployments and provider participation offer repeat utility; deployment and economics not tested.
trust: Public pricing, workflow examples, network counts and case study routes; comparisons remain project claims.
counter: Sparse hero is less visually distinctive; scroll-driven horizontal feature section produces repetition in static stitching.
principle: Show the practical workflow and cost proposition immediately after the brand statement.
avoid: Do not copy unverifiable savings claims or imply heterogeneous cloud instances are directly equivalent.
idea: Give the PONS concept a short interactive product preview and an explicit step-by-step creator workflow.
limitations: Scroll-driven horizontal cards repeat in the vertical composite; some hero assets may be minimal by design or not rendered. No pricing controls or deployment controls activated.
